paraphrase: For every supplied graph, each selected node’s full reflexive ancestor cone generated by finite paths is closed under all incoming edges. Positive predecessor availability at every node is equivalent to every full cone being headless. With explicit excluded middle, absence of any graph source is equivalent to that headless-cone coverage. Self-loops and cycles are allowed; neither infinitude nor a linear distinct-node chain is asserted. Empty graphs satisfy the universal clauses vacuously.
